name: Entrepreneur First
description: Talent investor that brings individuals together to find co-founders and build a company from before the idea stage.

name: EWOR
description: Fellowship for young founders that combines early funding with a founder community and mentoring.

name: Seedcamp
description: London-founded European seed fund that invests in early-stage startups and runs a founder community and events.

name: Antler
description: Global early-stage investor that runs residency programmes where founders meet co-founders and build from the idea stage; has a London presence.

name: Techstars
description: Accelerator network that runs mentor-led programmes in several cities. Check the site for whether a London programme is currently open.

name: Founders Factory
description: London-based venture builder and accelerator that works with corporate partners and invests in early-stage startups.

name: SFC Capital
description: UK early-stage investor backing startups with an application process open to founders.

name: Conception X
description: Cambridge-based programme that helps PhD students and researchers turn deep-science research into startups.

name: Creative Destruction Lab Oxford
description: Objectives-based mentoring programme for science and technology startups, hosted at the Saïd Business School in Oxford.

name: Imperial Enterprise Lab
description: Imperial College London's enterprise hub offering startup programmes and support for students, staff and alumni.

name: UCL Innovation & Enterprise
description: UCL's enterprise team, which supports students, staff and alumni starting companies, including the Hatchery programme.

name: Carbon13
description: Venture builder and accelerator for early-stage climate and nature startups.

name: Zinc
description: London-based venture builder that supports founders working on social and societal problems.

name: Bethnal Green Ventures
description: London-based early-stage investor and accelerator for startups that use technology to tackle social and environmental problems.

name: Barclays Eagle Labs
description: Barclays' startup support network offering workspace, events and business support for growing companies across the UK.

name: Google for Startups
description: Google's programmes and resources for startups, with accelerator and mentoring offers that vary by cohort and region.

name: Oxford Science Enterprises
description: Investor and company builder for science-based ventures coming out of the University of Oxford.

name: Y Combinator
description: US-based accelerator with an open application that accepts founders from any country, including the UK.

name: Capital Enterprise
description: London organisation that runs free support programmes and investor introductions for early-stage London startups.

name: Level39
description: Canary Wharf technology community focused on fintech, with workspace, events and corporate connections.
